notes.title: 【Major Update】FutureGPX CyberFormulaSIN VIER Rev.Y
notes.content:
FutureGPX CyberFormulaSIN VIER Rev.Y is Now Major Updated!
A new Steam client has been released and will be automatically downloaded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34010504/5f992b7cc301905455ac80d81ae73d7c0ff3e7d9.png[/img]

We have significantly improved the speed by reviewing all course data.
Enjoy the new comfort GPX Cyber Formula SIN VIER.

We are releasing a major update that includes machine balance adjustments.


[Update[
・ Improved image quality for all courses
・ Reduction of memory usage and speedup by optimizing processing

<Garland SF-03/G>
Enhances acceleration and braking performance.
⇒By strengthening the brakes, you can smoothly enter the corners and corner, and evolve into a machine that is even easier to handle!
<issuxark 00-X3/II S (Naoki Shinjo)>
Reduced air resistance.
⇒ The straight line growth is greatly improved! However, be careful as cornering becomes unstable on the contrary! Will it become a scary presence on high-speed circuits if you can master it! ?
<Exazard Z/A-11S (Shiba)>
Enhances acceleration and braking performance.
⇒ Originally a modified / two-stage boost machine, which has a well-established top speed. By covering the weaknesses of the low-speed range, is it a threat to the higher ranks?
<Nemesis AKF0-1/B>
Improves braking performance at low speeds.
⇒A machine with originally good cornering performance. You can now decelerate firmly when entering a corner, improving stability!

[Fixed]
・ Change spot appearance machine (adjust characters)
-Changed the participation machine of Championship 2023 (adjusted characters)
・ Change of machine read timing at machine select
-Fixed a bug in the display of the boost level of MS3B
・ Progress bar added to loading display
-Fixed a bug that title screen is not displayed in some environments.

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
We have added changing the starting grid at network races, which has been requested by many people!

・ Addition changing grids at network races.

* Grid change function
It is a function to change the starting grid during network competition.
Enter the grid change mode by pressing button 3 (S key) on the player entry screen
The grid can be swapped.

* Only the driver who held the race can change it.
